releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.3.0

- Bike Coach can now receive the connected athlete's cycling FTP, weight, power zones, selected 42-day, one-year, and all-time power-curve points, up to 200 recent activity summaries, and recent wellness trends.
- Every report names the one athlete it represents and labels detailed Intervals.icu coverage as complete, partial, or disabled.
- Failed power-curve or recent-activity retrieval now makes the report partial and prevents Bike Coach from presenting generic targets as confidently individualized.
- Coach instructions now require configured FTP, modeled FTP, historical best power, recovery, and current data coverage to be distinguished explicitly.
- Future planned-load projections are kept out of the current recovery status and wellness history.
- Accepted coaching calendar changes are immediately reread from Intervals.icu and confirmed alongside their exact request filenames.
- A new privacy control can disable detailed performance and recovery sharing. Credentials, keys, raw workout files, and GPS tracks are never included.
